list.title: Receiving
list.intro: Purchase orders sent to the supplier and waiting for goods, the one sent longest ago first. Choose a purchase order number to record what came.
list.count: {count, plural, one {# purchase order} other {# purchase orders}} waiting for goods
list.range: Purchase orders {from}–{to} of {total} (page {page} of {pages}), the one sent longest ago first
list.label: Purchase orders waiting for goods
list.noNumber: Purchase order without a number yet
list.sodApprover: You cannot receive it: you approved a document of this order
list.sodRequester: You cannot receive it: you are the requester
list.emptyTitle: No purchase order is waiting for goods
list.emptyHint: Purchase orders sent to the supplier for the departments you receive for, or for your own requests, come here, and you are notified when a new one arrives.
list.emptyPage: Nothing on this page is yours to receive; see the other pages below.
list.blockedHint: You approved the purchase request or the purchase order of these (also when acting for someone), so another receiver of the department receives them.
list.notReceiverHint: You may not receive goods yet. If you need to, ask your organization administrator to give you the receiver role.

po.APPROVED: Approved, not sent to the supplier yet
po.SENT: Sent to the supplier, waiting for goods

disposition.RETURN_EXCESS: Return the excess to the supplier

detail.title: Receive {number}
detail.notYoursHint: Only the people tied to this purchase order open it: the receivers of the requesting department (once it went to the supplier), the requesters, its approvers and the teams that look after purchase orders. If you need to receive it, contact your organization administrator.
detail.sodApprover: You cannot receive this purchase order yourself: you approved its purchase request or the purchase order (also when acting for someone), and an approver may not be the receiver. Another receiver of the department receives it.
detail.sodRequester: You cannot receive this purchase order yourself: you are the requester, and the DOA policy in effect does not let requesters receive their own goods. A receiver of the department receives it.
detail.viewOnly: You can see this purchase order; recording what came is the work of the receivers of the requesting department.
detail.notSent: This purchase order has not been sent to the supplier, so nothing can be received yet.

closedState.RECEIVED: Every line has come in full; there is nothing more to receive.
closedState.CLOSED: This purchase order is closed; nothing more can be received.
closedState.CANCELLED: This purchase order is cancelled; nothing can be received.

detail.closeShortWaiting: Procurement asked to close this purchase order short and it waits for approval. If goods arrive before then, record them as usual: only what has not come is given up.
detail.closeShortWaitingOther: A request to close this purchase order short waits for approval; the approver has been told.
detail.closeShortWaitsForDamaged: The purchase order cannot be closed short yet: what is not in is damaged goods waiting for approval to be kept. Wait for that decision first.
detail.askProcurement: If what is still to come will not come, ask procurement to close the purchase order short.

form.enterHint: Enter what came this time for each line. Leave lines that did not come empty.
form.keepPendingNote: Of this, {quantity} {uom} damaged wait for approval to be kept
form.whyOther: Another reason, such as the wrong model or size
form.deliveryNoteHint: From the delivery note that came with the goods; leave empty if there is none.
form.photosHint: Take photos of what came. Damaged goods need at least one photo.
form.photosRule: Pictures only: JPG, PNG or HEIC, up to 20 MB
form.uploadWait: A photo is still uploading. Wait for it to finish before checking or recording, or stop the upload in the photos field above.
form.reviewHint: See what will happen before you confirm. Once recorded you cannot change it; procurement can reverse it.
form.afterPartial: After this, the purchase order will be "Partly received" with {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} still to come
form.afterFull: After this, the purchase order will be "Received in full"
form.withinTolerance: {quantity} {uom} above the order, within the {pct}% allowed, so it is accepted at once
form.excessLegend: {quantity} {uom} above the order, beyond the {pct}% allowed: what should happen?
form.choiceAmountLabel: Worth at the purchase order price
form.returnExcess: Return the excess to the supplier, no approval needed
form.replaceDamaged: The supplier replaces them, no approval needed
form.donePending: {count, plural, one {# item waits} other {# items wait}} for approval; the approver has been told

fieldErrors.quantity: Enter a number with at most 4 decimals
fieldErrors.rejectedTooMany: What is refused cannot be more than what came
fieldErrors.photo: Take at least one photo of the damaged goods first
fieldErrors.nothing: Enter what came for at least one line
fieldErrors.choose: Choose what should happen before recording

approver.blocked: Not possible now: the DOA names no approver for receiving differences. Tell your organization administrator.
approver.beyondOrder: Not possible: the damaged goods are more than what is still to come, so they go back to the supplier.

history.title: Receipts so far
history.label: Goods receipts of this purchase order
history.empty: Nothing has been received on this purchase order yet. Recorded receipts appear here.
history.photoFailed: Photo {name} could not be opened. Try again; if it still fails, contact your administrator.

closeShort.title: Close the purchase order short
closeShort.hint: For when what is still to come will not come, for example the supplier stopped making it. It goes for approval by the DOA; goods that arrive meanwhile can still be received. Once approved, only what has not come is given up, its budget goes back, and nothing more can be received on this order.
closeShort.total: Budget given back once approved, at most
closeShort.reasonLabel: Why the order is closed short
closeShort.reasonHint: For example: the supplier no longer makes this model. The approver sees this reason.
closeShort.confirmLabel: I understand that once approved, nothing more can be received on this purchase order
closeShort.submit: Ask to close the purchase order
closeShort.done: Asked to close the purchase order; {count, plural, one {# line waits} other {# lines wait}} for approval
closeShort.requestsTitle: Requests to close the order short

errors.SOD_APPROVER: Not recorded: you approved the purchase request or the purchase order (also when acting for someone). Another receiver of the department receives it.
errors.SOD_REQUESTER: Not recorded: you are the requester, and the DOA policy in effect does not let requesters receive their own goods. A receiver of the department receives it.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this on this purchase order. If you think you should, contact your organization administrator.
errors.STATE: This purchase order has changed and cannot take goods now. Open the page again to see where it stands.
errors.CLOSE_SHORT_PENDING: A request to close this purchase order already waits for approval. Wait for its result.
errors.DAMAGED_PENDING: Not yet: what is not in is damaged goods waiting for approval to be kept. Wait for that decision first.
errors.NOTHING_SHORT: Every line came in full; there is nothing to close short.
errors.QUANTITY: Some quantities are not right: what came must be above 0 and what is refused no more than what came.
errors.NOTHING_RECEIVED: Enter what came for at least one line.
errors.EXCESS_CHOICE: There are {excess} units above the order with no choice to return or keep them. Check before recording again.
errors.DAMAGED_CHOICE: Choose whether the supplier replaces the damaged goods or you keep them.
errors.DAMAGED_BEYOND_ORDER: The damaged goods are more than what is still to come ({keepable} units), so they cannot be kept. Choose to have the supplier take them back.
errors.PHOTO_REQUIRED: Some goods are damaged: take at least one photo before recording.
errors.PHOTO: Only pictures (JPG, PNG, HEIC) you took or uploaded on this page and not attached to anything else can be used. Remove that file and take the photo again.
errors.LINE: A line is no longer on this purchase order. Open the page again and record again.
errors.REASON: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.CONFIRM: Tick to confirm first, because this cannot be undone
errors.TOLERANCE: The organization's allowance for receiving more than ordered is not set correctly. Tell your organization administrator.
errors.AI_REVIEW_PENDING: Quantities the AI read from the delivery note still wait for you: confirm every line in the AI box, or change the quantity yourself, then record again
errors.BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough budget for what came above the order ({available} baht left, {shortfall} baht short). Receive less, or tell the budget administrator.
errors.BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT_PLAIN: There is not enough budget for what came above the order. Receive less, or tell the budget administrator.
errors.BUDGET_LINE_CLOSED: The budget line of this item is closed. Tell the budget administrator.
errors.NO_APPROVER: The DOA names no approver for receiving differences yet. Choose to return instead, or tell your organization administrator.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This purchase order was not found; it may be gone or you may not see it.
errors.BUSY: Someone else is recording on this purchase order. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with other details. Open the page again and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: You are signed out. Sign in again and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Try again; if it still fails, give your administrator the reference {requestId}.
errors.FAILED: Not recorded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.CHECK_FAILED: The check did not go through, and nothing has been recorded yet. Check your connection and press Check before recording again.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back, so it is not certain it was recorded. Check your connection and press the same button again without changing anything; it is not recorded twice.
